causalPolicy.admission: Immutable linear intent queue saves exact predecessor, expected/future revisions, rich content, original null-address codec envelope and reservation capture; canonical truth stays pinned to pending CREATE.
causalPolicy.activation: Deferred canonical materialization only after exact present predecessor ACK, under scoped locks and fresh lease/credential clocks; one execution row/attempt, rollback together on failed settlement.
causalPolicy.resolution: Host-owned immutable semantic lineage witness proves exact original CREATE reserved-to-present source generation g to g+1, same task ID, real strong tag and full projection pair. Original queued payload/capture retain epoch g.
causalPolicy.runtime: Typed current-attempt predecessor proof is frozen before credentials and revalidated before mutation and ACK; shared kernel has no mapping or ancestor-query authority.
causalPolicy.strictReference: Actual CREATE present ACK required. No no-task proof or fictional absence ACK; unresolved/unknown CREATE leaves all successors waiting without HTTP.
causalPolicy.separateApiPolicy: Reference defers canonical materialization; Musubi immediate canonical edits/no-resource compatibility are separately evidenced API policy.
causalPolicy.createRecovery: Sticky possible dispatch forbids a second POST; no candidate ID means HOLD without content search; exact captured-ID full-target GET only.
causalPolicy.pairedAck: CREATE/UPDATE store immutable present ID/validator/full projection evidence atomically with ACK; DELETE records actual exact absence without a fake tag or provider acceptance.

limits: Provider credentials/resources are synthetic owned loopback fixtures. External DNS/TLS/providers, real OAuth and live writes are not exercised.

Installed production CLI/native provider/shared runtime/encrypted credential ports/PostgreSQL/container SIGKILL are real. Bounded transport preload refuses nonfixture native origins and preserves logical native URLs; no source bind mounts or production fixture flags.
ENVIRONMENT=test belongs only to installed test harnesses; production CLI containers receive REFERENCE configuration only plus bounded test transport preload.

Queued intent adds no eleventh endpoint profile; general cancellation/supersession, hierarchy/move/assignment/reorder, recurrence, task import, OAuth refresh, resurrection, other task providers and fanout remain separate gates.
Old and new workers run serially across forward migration. No downgrade or mixed-version worker contract is claimed.
Reference strict actual-present completion and deferred canonical materialization do not claim the API host no-resource/immediate-materialization policy.
Only nonce databases and containers owned by this proof are removed. Shared QA PostgreSQL remains root-owned unless an explicit root cleanup receipt is attached.
